messages:
Maya: Heads up — I'm trying to push a Terraform change to add 4x A100s in eu-west-1 for batch jobs and the PR is blocked by a policy check.
Omar: yep we landed the freeze window last week for the release, instance-type changes are restricted during freeze. what's the PR #?
Maya: #4821
Jordan: the CI runs Conftest/OPA as a preflight. It purposely blocks instance_type changes during freeze unless an exception ticket is referenced.
Maya: is there a defined exception flow? i couldn't find it in the PR template.
Priya: there is — open an infra-exception ticket in the infra-approvals board, get 2 approvers (eng-infra + cost-sig), then add the ticket id to the PR body as `infra-exception: <ID>` and CI will let it through.
Maya: can we do an emergency exception for prod only? this change is for staging though.
Omar: staging shouldn't be granted exceptions by default; we want to avoid cost creep. if it's research-related, put it in the `research` cost-bucket and quotas apply.
Priya: if it's genuinely urgent, tag @oncall and include `infra-exception: emergency-<ticket>` in the PR. oncall + infra-lead signoff required.
Maya: ok i can hold this until after the freeze. low priority, just wanted to check. for the future, can we make the CI error message clearer and link the exception flow?
Jordan: agreed — also thinking longer term we should move this policy closer to Argo/Helm (admission) so syncs fail fast instead of letting changes land and then blocking during promotion.
Priya: FYI here's the simplified Conftest/OPA rule we run in CI (we can extend it):
```
package infra.freeze

violation[msg] {
  input.change.type == "instance_type"
  input.time in freeze_window
  msg = "instance-type changes disallowed during freeze"
}
```
Omar: we could extend the rule to validate `input.metadata.ticket_id` against a small approvals store (Dynamo/Sheets) so approved exceptions are auto-allowed.
Maya: that would be sweet. i'll open the infra ticket and follow the exception flow. also can we add the infra-approvals link to the PR ci message so new engineers aren't confused?
SRE-Bot: deploy-checker: PR #4821 blocked by policy infra.freeze. See https://redwood.internal/docs/infra/freezes — run `make infra-exception` to start the approval flow. :lock:
Priya: i'll update the PR template and CI message today to include the doc and a short checklist for exceptions.
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
